 Lucas Havrisik works out for Raiders 
 by Ari Koslow | Thu, Nov 19th 2026, 5:28pm EST 
 The Raiders hosted free agent K Lucas Havrisik for a workout on Thursday. ( Ryan McFadden on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The Raiders worked out three kickers as Matt Gay deals with a hip injury. 
 #Raiders worked out three kickers: Lucas Havrisik, Younghoe Koo and John Parker Romo. 
K Matt Gay is dealing with a hip injury.
— Ryan McFadden (@ryanmcfadden_) November 19, 2026
